summary: chore(content-server): remove Backbone email-first and index views
description:
Because:

* React serves /, /oauth and /authorization in stage and prod, so the
  Backbone email-first views and their mixins are dead code.

This commit:

* Switches the (/), authorization and oauth routes to createReactViewHandler.
* Deletes the index, authorization and ready views, 11 mixins and their specs.
* Removes the emailFirstRoutes and simpleRoutes flags and showReactApp config.
* Removes the FXA-14379 leftovers in app-start.js and verification reasons.

Closes FXA-14378
